warnings: B3 and B3' are one member line on every grid 1-7: B3 spans 6.50 between the columns on A and B, B3' cantilevers 2.00 to the corridor edge C; both 0.20 x 0.65. The elevation shows 2-Ø19 bent bars bending up 1.30 (= L/5) from each B3 support and continuing as top bars into B3'.

Conflict, B3' bottom bars: the B3' cross-section prints '2-Ø25มม' on the bottom face while the B3' elevation labels the bottom bar '2-Ø19มม'. Took the cross-section (the member's own section callout; spec precedence section/detail first) and lowered the score — the elevation reading (2-Ø19) is plausible for a compression face.
B3 stirrups: the cross-section prints ป-Ø6 @0.15 while the elevation shows @0.10 over the 1.30 zone next to the B support — spacing_mm takes the smaller with variable_spacing.
Sheet footnote: 'หมายเหตุ หรือรายการการเสริมเหล็กให้เป็นไปตามข้อกำหนดในหนังสือมาตรฐานประกอบแบบก่อสร้าง' — the referenced standard book is not part of this set.
The stair detail has no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned; its tread/riser chain stays on the element (the 0.16 x 5 riser ticks are also z levels in the grid master).
